bugs.description: The prompt template uses `{{{input.meetingDetails}}}` instead of `{{{meetingDetails}}}`, causing the `meetingDetails` value to be `null` or `undefined` within the AI prompt's context.
The AI prompt instruction was modified to omit asking for 'action items', leading to silent data loss as the model may no longer reliably extract and return them.
The `meetingDetails` Zod schema uses `.length(10)` which restricts input to exactly 10 characters, instead of `.min(10)` which would allow any length greater than or equal to 10.
